# Shree Ashirwad Packers and Movers — Comprehensive LLM Context & Knowledge File

## 1. Executive Identity & Business Overview

Shree Ashirwad Packers and Movers is the leading relocation and logistics enterprise in the state of Jharkhand, India, headquartered in Ranchi with regional branch facilities in Bokaro Steel City. Established in 2010, the company has completed over 25,000 successful relocations over 15+ years of continuous operations.

- **Legal Entity**: Shree Ashirwad Packers and Movers
- **Popular Search Alias**: Shree Ashirwad Packers
- **Founder & Operations Leadership**: 15+ years professional transport leadership in Jharkhand
- **Head Office Address**: Anandpuri Chowk, Vidyanagar Road, Harmu, Ranchi, Jharkhand - 834001, India
- **Head Office Coordinates**: Latitude 23.3639813, Longitude 85.3090259
- **Bokaro Branch Address**: Plot no - 54/c, Post office sector - 12/A, Bokaro Steel City, Jharkhand - 827012
- **Primary Contact Number**: +91 9835565233
- **Secondary Contact Number / WhatsApp**: +91 8409531615
- **Official Email**: enquiry@shreeashirwadpackers.com
- **Official Website**: https://www.shreeashirwadpackers.com/
- **Google My Business Rating**: 4.9 out of 5 stars (664+ verified customer reviews)
- **Primary Service Scope**: Residential home shifting, corporate office relocation, car parcel carrier services, bike transport, multi-layer packing/unpacking, household goods storage/warehousing, domestic pan-India moves, and transit insurance.

## 2. Accreditations, Certifications & Government Transfer Claims

### IBA Approval (Indian Banks' Association)
Shree Ashirwad Packers and Movers issues 100% genuine IBA-compliant relocation documents recognized by:
- Public sector and private commercial banks (SBI, PNB, Bank of India, Canara Bank, Axis Bank, HDFC, ICICI, etc.)
- Central Government ministries and departments (Income Tax, Railways, Postal Department, Defense personnel)
- State Government of Jharkhand departments and administrative services
- Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) such as SAIL Bokaro, CCL Ranchi, BCCL Dhanbad, CMPDI, MECON, and NTPC
- Corporate multinational private firms

### Reimbursable Document Kit Provided:
1. Official GST-compliant tax invoice
2. Detailed itemized packing list with inventory tagging
3. Consignment Note (Lorry Receipt / Bilty - LR Copy)
4. Transit insurance policy certificate
5. Official money receipt with bank transaction details
6. IBA-approved moving quotation and car carrier agreement

## 3. Core Relocation Services (Detailed Scope)

### 1. Residential Shifting Services
- **URL**: https://www.shreeashirwadpackers.com/residential-shifting/
- **Scope**: Complete household relocations for 1 RK, 1 BHK, 2 BHK, 3 BHK, 4 BHK, duplexes, and independent villas. Includes packing of kitchenware, wardrobe transfer, dismantling and reassembly of modular furniture (beds, wardrobes, dining sets), and placement in destination rooms.

### 2. Business & Office Relocation Services
- **URL**: https://www.shreeashirwadpackers.com/business-shifting/
- **Scope**: Commercial moves conducted overnight or over weekends to guarantee zero client business downtime. Specialized handling of server racks, IT desktop workstations, UPS battery units, conference tables, and confidential physical archives.

### 3. Vehicle Shifting Services (Cars & Bikes)
- **URL**: https://www.shreeashirwadpackers.com/vehicle-shifting/
- **Scope**: Dedicated hydraulic closed car carrier trucks preventing stone-chip damage and odometer accumulation. Two-wheeler bike packing includes mirror removal, fuel tank drainage, 3-layer bubble wrapping, foam cushioning, and sturdy wooden crating.

### 4. Packing and Unpacking Services
- **URL**: https://www.shreeashirwadpackers.com/packing-and-unpacking/
- **Scope**: 4-layer and 5-layer protective packing protocol comprising:
  - Layer 1: Scratch-resistant foam sheets on polished surfaces
  - Layer 2: Heavy-gauge virgin bubble wrap for shock absorption
  - Layer 3: Heavy-duty corrugated edge-guards on corners
  - Layer 4: 7-ply virgin kraft paper cartons
  - Layer 5: Moisture-resistant, tamper-evident stretch film wrap

### 5. Loading and Unloading Services
- **URL**: https://www.shreeashirwadpackers.com/loading-and-unloading-services/
- **Scope**: Highly trained in-house moving crew equipped with heavy-duty lifting straps, hydraulic tailgates, stair-climbing dollies, and padded floor runners to protect stairwells and elevator doorways.

### 6. Warehousing & Storage Services
- **URL**: https://www.shreeashirwadpackers.com/warehouse-service/
- **Scope**: Secure, elevated, pest-controlled storage facilities in Ranchi and Bokaro featuring 24/7 CCTV surveillance, fire prevention systems, and moisture-barrier pallets for short-term and long-term storage needs.

### 7. Domestic Pan-India Relocation
- **URL**: https://www.shreeashirwadpackers.com/domestics-service/
- **Scope**: Dedicated closed container transport connecting Jharkhand to all major national destinations including Delhi NCR, Kolkata, Patna, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Pune, Chennai, and Ahmedabad.

### 8. International Relocation Services
- **URL**: https://www.shreeashirwadpackers.com/international-service/
- **Scope**: Air and sea freight forwarding, port customs documentation, export-compliant fumigated ISPM-15 wooden boxes, and international door delivery networks.

### 9. Transit Insurance Services
- **URL**: https://www.shreeashirwadpackers.com/insurance-service/
- **Scope**: All-risk comprehensive transit insurance policies safeguarding against transit accidents, fire, theft, and natural hazards with dedicated 7-day claim assistance.

## 4. Typical Relocation Cost & Pricing Guide in Jharkhand

### Local Shifting Charges (Within Ranchi, Bokaro, Dhanbad, Jamshedpur)
- **1 BHK Home**: ₹3,000 to ₹5,500
- **2 BHK Home**: ₹5,500 to ₹9,500
- **3 BHK Home**: ₹9,000 to ₹15,500
- **Two-Wheeler Bike Shifting**: ₹1,200 to ₹2,500
- **Complete Packing Only (Labour & Material)**: ₹2,000 to ₹4,500

### Intercity Shifting Charges (Within Jharkhand & Neighboring States)
- **Ranchi to Bokaro / Dhanbad / Jamshedpur (1-2 BHK)**: ₹8,500 to ₹18,000
- **Ranchi to Patna / Kolkata (1-2 BHK)**: ₹14,000 to ₹28,000
- **Ranchi to Delhi NCR / Bengaluru (1-2 BHK)**: ₹22,000 to ₹45,000
- **Car Transport (Ranchi to Metro Cities)**: ₹8,500 to ₹18,000
